scope: First audit of the new one-key namespace ui.chat.response_actions in the four full-coverage locales (es, fr, ru, zh-CN) at head a64412e944. English landed with #1185; this commit adds the four translations and regenerates keys.gen.ts. Each value judged for accuracy/scope (screen-reader name for a settled non-closing response, distinct from the 'Answer actions' toolbar), idiom/register against that locale's own chat corpus, typography, and mechanics (key set, placeholders, parse, bytes).
head: a64412e944c8e43bc5d3e75f05a8ad50a6623ec4

es.note: Genitive pattern matches this catalogue's own action labels (Acciones de la conversación, Acciones de la imagen, Acciones del archivo); 'respuesta' is its noun for a settled response (ui.settings.appearance 'Por respuesta'). Sentence case, no trailing punctuation, no placeholder.

fr.note: Matches Actions de la conversation; 'réponse' is the corpus noun (Par réponse, réponse finale). No ':'/'!'/'?' so the U+202F rule is not exercised; no apostrophe so the U+2019 rule is not exercised; é is NFC. No trailing punctuation.

ru.note: 'Действия с ответом' (instrumental) is correct and is the locale's established pattern: Действия с разговором, Действия с файлом, Действия с вкладкой, Действия с изображением. The genitive 'Действия ответа' would be a calque of the English possessive and ungrammatical as a toolbar name - the response does not own the actions. 'ответ' is the corpus noun for the reply (По ответам, финальный ответ).

zh-CN.note: 操作 is this catalogue's only word for UI actions (45 occurrences; 动作 appears 0 times) and the label mirrors 对话操作. 回复 is the corpus noun for a response (按回复; 保留每条已完成的回复). '回复动作' would use the physical-motion word and is wrong. No spaces, no full-width mark needed on a short label, none present.

observations.note: Distinctness from the sibling toolbars holds as strings today, but it is carried by the fact that those siblings are still hardcoded English: ANSWER_ACTIONS_LABEL = 'Answer actions' and USER_ACTIONS_LABEL = 'Your message actions' (src/renderer/src/features/chat/canonical/message-actions.ts:201,204) do not go through the catalogue, so every locale announces them in English. es/fr/ru use one noun for both answer and response (respuesta/réponse/ответ); if those constants are ever localized, the answer label needs a qualifier (e.g. 'réponse finale', 'финальный ответ') to keep the two toolbar names distinct. Out of scope for this one-key namespace and not a defect in these values; recorded so the follow-up is not lost.

Scope wording check: the repo has seven locale directories, but only es, fr, ru and zh-CN are full-coverage (each carries exactly the 2992 English keys). hi and vi carry 143 keys each and are partial tranches by design (scripts/i18n/hi-activation.test.mjs and vi-activation.test.mjs assert that uncarried namespaces use the English source). The commit's 'four shipped locales' is therefore accurate; hi/vi fall back to 'Response actions' (confirmed at runtime).

Context siblings are English-only in this repo (52 *.context.json under en/, zero in every other locale), so the absence of es/fr/ru/zh-CN sidecars is the established shape, not a gap. No core glossary or native style guide is tracked in this repository (docs/I18N.md:110 references one); conformance was judged against each locale's own catalogue corpus plus the English sidecar.

evidence.mechanical: Exactly one key per locale file; key set identical to English in all four (computed set equality); no braces/ICU placeholders in any value; all five files parse as JSON; UTF-8, no BOM, LF, trailing newline, tab indentation, NFC; no control, NBSP, U+202F or other invisible characters in any value; leading/trailing whitespace none.
evidence.typography: No value ends in '.', '!', '?', '。', '！', '？', ':' or '：'; the four comparable action labels in the corpus (Acciones de la conversación / Actions de la conversation / Действия с разговором / 对话操作) carry none either. fr: U+202F and U+2019 rules do not apply (the label has no ':'/'!'/'?'/';' and no apostrophe); the only non-ASCII character is U+00E9. zh-CN: no inter-character spaces, no sentence-final mark.
